{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past purchases as continuing demand for broadly related items, with insufficient attention to the specific need behind the next choice.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend repeated, specific interests, such as circuit building, connectivity, vocal music, or melodic metal.",
    "Useful complements and additions that provide a distinct capability often match users' reasons for choosing an item."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related products and albums compete with stronger matches despite serving different tasks, musical preferences, or equipment requirements.",
    "Past ownership is treated as demand for more versions or supplies, even when recent purchases may already satisfy the need.",
    "Older or occasional interests remain influential when recent behavior suggests a different priority; sparse movie histories yield few personally convincing matches."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product domains, ecosystems, artists, or broad genres appear to substitute for matching the specific purpose or qualities users value.",
    "Repeated purchasing appears to imply replenishment or expansion without enough evidence of an unmet need."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent, repeated, task-specific behavior should distinguish active interests from isolated or older purchases.",
    "Compatibility, dimensions, capacity, quantity, and existing ownership determine whether a related product is actually useful.",
    "Specific musical qualities, familiarity, and recent listening direction distinguish compelling choices from merely related recordings."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items often establish general relevance but lack the specific fit, distinct benefit, or current need that would turn relevance into an immediate choice.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, distinguished from items they consider relevant but would defer.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to redundant ownership, unsupported projects, incompatible requirements, or excessive quantities.",
    "The frequency with which users prefer a lower-ranked specific match over a higher-ranked broad association.",
    "The proportion of recommendations whose personal relevance users cannot establish, tracked separately from explicit content mismatch."
  ]
}
